page.title: Orders
page.description: Orders guests placed in your menu. Call them back, then mark each one done.

empty.title: No orders yet
empty.description: When a guest orders from your menu it lands here, with a sound.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this order?
cancelDialog.description: It stays in your history, marked cancelled. The guest's order page will say it was cancelled; call them if they need to know why.

card.openMap: Open their location on the map
card.changed_other: Changed by the guest {{count}} times, last at {{time}}

whatsapp.title: Your orders go to WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: Guests send each order to your WhatsApp, so you handle it there and it doesn't show here. To get orders here instead, with the guest's phone and address and a sound when one arrives, let guests order in your menu.
whatsapp.earlier: New orders open in WhatsApp. Below are the ones guests placed in your menu before.

alert.title: New order
alert.description: A guest just ordered from your menu.
alert.changedDescription: A guest changed an order they placed. Check it before you accept it.

tables.title: Table orders
tables.description: Orders guests placed from the QR code on their table, by table, waiting longest first.
tables.emptyDescription: When a guest scans the QR code on their table and orders, it shows here with the table's name and a sound.

deleteDialog.title: Delete order {{reference}}?
deleteDialog.description: The order and everything in it are deleted for good. It leaves your analytics, and a guest following it no longer can. To keep a record, cancel it instead.

edit.title: Edit order {{reference}}
edit.description: Change how many of each dish, take one off, or add dishes. Dishes already on it keep the price they were ordered at.
edit.descriptionNew: Change how many of each dish, take one off, or add dishes. Saving accepts the order, so the guest can no longer change it.
edit.dishPlaceholder: Pick a dish from your menu
edit.empty: An order needs at least one dish. To call it off, cancel it.
